faqs.question: What is Microsoft Power Platform?
faqs.answer: Power Platform is a suite of low-code tools—Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Virtual Agents—designed to accelerate business transformation.

faqs.question: Can Power Platform integrate with non-Microsoft services?
faqs.answer: Yes, it integrates with over 700+ connectors, including third-party services like Salesforce, Google, and SAP.

faqs.question: Who can use Power Platform?
faqs.answer: Both technical developers and business users with minimal coding experience can use Power Platform effectively.
